title: Multiplication on encoded binary expansions
statement: For natural numbers $a$ and $b$, let $\operatorname{bits}(n)$ denote the bit string representing $n$. Applying the operation that decodes a paired input, multiplies the values of its two components, and returns the resulting bit string to the encoding of $\operatorname{bits}(a)$ and $\operatorname{bits}(b)$ yields $\operatorname{bits}(ab)$.
